name: pumbility-farmer
description: Farm Pumbility for Pump It Up Phoenix

paragraphs: Pumbility Farmer is a PIU Phoenix difficulty analyzer and Vercel web UI with Scoring, Clearing, and Pumbility tier lists. Its scoring list combines normalized Phoenix 1 and Phoenix 2 score evidence against the current Phoenix 2 catalog. Phoenix 1 is a frozen, privacy-safe source captured on August 7, 2026; Phoenix 2 remains live and uses the upstream mix=Phoenix2 filter. Singles and Doubles rankings are completely independent. Co-op has its own combined 2x-5x scoring analysis because those charts have no official difficulty rating. Published Singles and Doubles analysis starts at level 16,…
